visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a static close-up shot of a steaming, vibrant bowl of Italian soup noodles, filled with clams, cabbage, and tomato slices. Steam rises gently against a bright, modern kitchen backdrop. (2) Hands enter the frame over a yellow cutting board, using a sharp metal knife to rhythmically slice green leeks, white onions, garlic cloves, and a ripe red tomato. Each action is shown in a tight close-up, highlighting the texture of the vegetables. (3) In a transition to a cooking phase, hands drop a bundle of dried spaghetti into a pot of vigorously bubbling water on an induction stove. A black spatula is used to stir the noodles as they soften in the steam-filled environment. (4) Inside a lavender-colored ceramic pot, olive oil is poured, followed by sliced leeks, onions, and minced garlic. The camera captures the ingredients turning translucent as they sizzle, and hands grind black pepper directly into the pot for seasoning. (5) A metal container of fresh clams is emptied into the pot, and white wine is poured from a bottle, creating a burst of steam. A matching lavender lid is placed over the pot to trap the heat. (6) The lid is lifted to reveal the clams have opened. Broth is added from a white pitcher, followed by the previously chopped tomatoes and large pieces of fresh green cabbage. The cooked spaghetti is then returned to the simmering broth. (7) Final garnishes including extra garlic, a drizzle of sesame oil from a glass bottle, and fresh leek greens are added to the surface of the finished dish. (8) A woman with short black hair, wearing a white shirt and a pink apron, sits in a well-lit kitchen. She uses chopsticks to eat the noodles and clams from a bowl, smiling and looking directly at the camera to express her satisfaction with the meal.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a bright, mid-tempo acoustic guitar and piano BGM in a major key. There is a soft 'whoosh' sound effect as the video starts. (2) A sharp, rhythmic thudding sound occurs as a knife cuts through leeks on a cutting board, followed by more rapid chopping SFX for onions and garlic. The BGM remains steady. (3) A bubbling water sound is audible as spaghetti is dropped into the pot, accompanied by a soft splashing effect. (4) A sizzling sound marks the moment aromatics hit the oil in the pan. The mechanical clicking and grinding sound of a pepper mill is clearly heard over the music. (5) The distinct clinking of clam shells hitting a ceramic pot is audible, followed by the liquid pouring sound of white wine and a heavy thud as the lid is placed. (6) A soft suction or pop sound effect occurs as the lid is removed, followed by more liquid pouring SFX and the wet stirring sound of noodles and vegetables being mixed in broth. (7) Metallic clinks and scrapes are heard as garnish is added. (8) A female narrator begins speaking with a cheerful, high-arousal tone, praising the meal. Short slurping and chewing sounds are heard as she tastes the noodles, followed by enthusiastic verbal confirmation of the flavor.
